name: Mailboxes a user can access
description: Lists the mailboxes one user has Full Access, Send As or Send on Behalf on.

parameters.name: MaxMailboxes
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes to check
parameters.help: Stops after this many mailboxes and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Full Access granted through a group is shown against the group, not the user.
